description: This file defines the TransactionProvider class, which manages state related to transactions in a personal expense tracker app. It interacts with the TransactionRepository to fetch, add, seed, and filter transaction data, and provides aggregate information such as total income, total expense, balance, and expenses by category.

classes.name: TransactionProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-derived class that provides transaction data and operations for a Flutter app, including fetching, adding, seeding sample data, and filtering transactions.

methods.name: seedSampleData
methods.description: Seeds the repository with sample data and notifies listeners to update UI.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Adds a new transaction to the repository and notifies listeners.

methods.name: totalIncome
methods.description: Calculates the total income from all transactions.

methods.name: totalExpense
methods.description: Calculates the total expenses from all transactions.

methods.name: balance
methods.description: Calculates the net balance (income minus expenses).

methods.name: expenseByCategory
methods.description: Provides a map of categories to total expense amounts within each category.

methods.name: filtered
methods.description: Returns a list of transactions filtered by optional category and type.
